mapper.insert:
select 'WRN' || lpad(nextval('WRITR_MBER_NO')::text, 9, '0')
INSERT INTO WRITR_INFO ( MBER_NO, GNRL_MBER_NO, NM, ACT_CODE, ACT_AREA, TELNO, SELF_INTRCN, WRITR_FILE_NO, REPRSNT_PRDCT_FILE_NO, PRDCT_NM, MNFCT_YEAR, PRDCT_DC, RQSTDT, JDGMN_STTUS_CODE, JDGMN_STTUS_CHANGE_DT, JDGMN_NO, JDGMN_OPINION, JDGMN_SUMRY, MBER_STTUS_CODE, CREAT_MBER_NO, CREAT_DT, CHANGE_MBER_NO, CHANGE_DT ) VALUES ( #{mberNo}, #{gnrlMberNo}, #{nm}, #{actCode}, #{actArea}, #{telno}, #{selfIntrcn}, #{writrFileNo}, #{reprsntPrdctFileNo}, #{prdctNm}, #{mnfctYear}, #{prdctDc}, CURRENT_DATE, #{jdgmnSttusCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{jdgmnNo}, #{jdgmnOpinion}, #{jdgmnSumry}, #{mberSttusCode}, #{creatMberNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{changeMberNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: update WRITR_INFO set WRITR_FILE_NO = coalesce(nullif(#{writrFileNo}, ''), WRITR_FILE_NO) , REPRSNT_PRDCT_FILE_NO = coalesce(nullif(#{reprsntPrdctFileNo}, ''), REPRSNT_PRDCT_FILE_NO) , JDGMN_NO = coalesce(nullif(#{jdgmnNo}, ''), JDGMN_NO) , change_mber_no = #{changeMberNo} , change_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where mber_no = #{mberNo}
mapper.select: select MBER_NO , GNRL_MBER_NO , NM , ACT_CODE , ACT_AREA , TELNO , SELF_INTRCN , WRITR_FILE_NO , REPRSNT_PRDCT_FILE_NO , PRDCT_NM , MNFCT_YEAR , PRDCT_DC , RQSTDT , JDGMN_STTUS_CODE , JDGMN_STTUS_CHANGE_DT , JDGMN_NO , JDGMN_OPINION , JDGMN_SUMRY , MBER_STTUS_CODE , CREAT_MBER_NO , CREAT_DT , CHANGE_MBER_NO , CHANGE_DT from writr_info where gnrl_mber_no = #{gnrlMberNo}

select a.mber_no , a.gnrl_mber_no , a.nm , a.act_area , a.self_intrcn , a.writr_file_no , a.reprsnt_prdct_file_no , a.prdct_nm , a.mnfct_year , a.prdct_dc , a.rqstdt , a.jdgmn_sttus_code , a.jdgmn_sttus_change_dt , a.jdgmn_no , a.jdgmn_opinion , a.jdgmn_sumry , a.mber_sttus_code , a.creat_mber_no , a.creat_dt , a.change_mber_no , a.change_dt from writr_info a where a.mber_no = #{mberNo}
and a.mber_sttus_code = #{mberSttusCode}
